title: MockMob NTA-mode paper blueprint
description: How one CUET UG subject paper is built. Every range is {min, target, max}: an engine aims for target and must stay within min..max. Counts are questions out of 50 unless stated. Chapter names are MockMob canonical chapter names (data/canonical_syllabus.js), which are the values stored in questions.chapter. Spec and sources: docs/brain/NTA-PATTERN-SPEC.md.

aliases.description: Other stored chapter names that count toward this quota.

subtypes.description: English only: question-type quotas inside the chapter.

name.description: Syllabus unit (MockMob canonical unit name where one exists).

questions.description: Exact number of questions in this section.

positions.description: First and last question number of the section in the paper.

exam.description: Rules from the Information Bulletin (identical for every subject). attemptNote explains sectioned papers.

variants.description: One paper layout per candidate choice. Mathematics: core (A+B1) and applied (A+B2). Computer Science: cs (A+B1) and ip (A+B2). Others: one 'default' variant. Section question counts sum to 50.

excludedChapters.description: Stored chapters that are not in the 2026 syllabus and must never enter an NTA paper.

typeQuotas.description: Standalone questions (outside passage sets) by type; see _types.json. Targets plus sets.questions.target equal 50.

overlays.description: Features counted across types (numerical_share is a fraction of all 50; code_or_query_output is a count).

sets.description: Passage or case sets. A set is always served whole, inside one chapter, at the stated positions.

difficulty.description: Fractions of the 50 by MockMob difficulty label. Inferred: NTA publishes no difficulty mix.

evidence.description: What was counted in real papers or reports, confidence per aspect (high, medium, low) and the list of inferred fields.
